title: Owner Payments Toward Storage Statements, Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference
content:
## Applies to

On a Repair Estimates & Appointments insurance-claim booking the storage on a statement is shared between the insurer and the vehicle owner, and the owner settles the owner's part of a storage statement charge with one payment of their own on that charge.

The owner's payment toward a storage statement is worked out only after the booking carries a storage charge billing every day from the end of the free storage days through the statement date. The owner's payment toward a storage statement is not fixed until that storage charge carries the storage goodwill booked on storage statements.

## How it is invoked

The payment is the owner's own act. The desk unlocks the customer-side tool `pay_estimate_charge_54cbd3ef` and hands it over to the customer themselves, who runs it in person; the desk gives the owner the booking and charge reference numbers to quote. The tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the owner's estimate booking, as given to the owner by the desk from the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `charge_event_id` | Reference number of the charge being paid, as given to the owner by the desk from the booking history or a posting receipt | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Amount the owner pays toward that charge | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |
| `payment_method` | How the owner pays | One of the values below |

`payment_method` values:

- `card` — the owner pays with a credit or debit card;
- `ach` — the owner pays by bank transfer from a checking account;
- `cash` — the owner pays in cash at the center;
- `check` — the owner pays by personal check;
- `insurer_direct` — only when the insurer itself remits the money, which an owner paying in person never uses.

## Return

The tool applies the payment to that charge, dated today, and lowers its outstanding amount by the sum paid. The confirmation names the new payment reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the charge reference number paid, the amount paid in USD with 2 decimals and the payment method; seeing that reference number means the payment was applied. The owner receives the payment reference number for their records.
